methodology: Production pages; rotated renderer order and, when configured, alternating before/after builds in one browser. Per-build sources describe the served app; runnerSha256 identifies the common harness even if the archived baseline has an older harness copy. Public paste includes bracketed-paste event plus write echo; write measures public parse callback. Separate warm synchronous parser-only throughput disables render scheduling, 4 warm iterations then 16 measured; this does not measure GPU/display frames. Complete bounded buffer raw cells, combined strings, wrap flags and cursor are hashed after measurement. Unicode11 is an explicit unchanged fallback control. Scrollback 1000; stock font and cursorBlink=false. First public operation is retained separately from warm parse. Profile runs are separate from timing.
